title: Diode burns out above its current or surge rating

implements.text: The diode latches burnt when average current exceeds imax (default 1 A) or the peak exceeds isurge (default 30 A)

mocked.text: Once the rule fires the part stays burnt until it is repaired; the real part may survive or fail more slowly

unsupported.text: Thermal history; only the threshold and its dwell are checked

validation.dataset: figures/engine/bench-solve.test.mjs: no flyback diode: the motor reports the spike; with it the diode clamps

operatingRange.evidence: RS-08 C13 and C14: 12.3 and 12.4 percent at 1 to 4 mA

knownFailureCases: imax and isurge are the 1N4007 headline ratings; other diodes use the same defaults
